name: solitude
description: The state of being alone or at least not having any social attention.
perceptions: It's been a while since I've had meaningful social contact with someone.
results: Depending on the context, you may enjoy the experience or not. See the variations.

variations.name: loneliness
variations.description: Sadness from lack of significant social attention.
perceptions: It's been a while since I've had meaningful social contact with someone.
I need to be seen and understood.

guidance.description: There are lots of ways to deal with loneliness and isolation. The solution depends on what's causing these feelings.

comparisons.description: 'Loneliness' is when you're without social contact and you desire validation of your place in the world. 'Solitude' is also without social contact, but no need for validation.

variations.name: positive solitude
variations.description: A sense that you're alone and the lack of social pressure helps create an experience of joy, tranquility, or productivity.
perceptions: I'm alone, but don't desire social contact right now.
The lack of social stimulation is good for me right now.

guidance.description: If you sometimes like to be alone, these articles may help find ways to carve out that space and enjoy it.

commentaries.quote: I want to be seen, to be understood deeply and to not be so very lonely.
Loneliness and the feeling of being unwanted is the most terrible poverty.
Parenting alone can also feel isolating, especially when your children are younger. You can naturally miss adult company.
We are all born alone and die alone. The loneliness is definitely part of the journey of life.
Who knows what true loneliness is - not the conventional word but the naked terror? To the lonely themselves it wears a mask. The most miserable outcast hugs some memory or some illusion.
I never found the companion that was so companionable as solitude.
If you are never alone, you cannot know yourself.
I restore myself when I'm alone.
